# log

```go
import "github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/log"
```

Package log is an abstraction build around the standard library own \`log\` implementation\. It enables some nice customization around how the messages are logged\. Such as a level based prefix with a fitting filter\.

## type [Level](<https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/blob/master/log/enum.go#L15>)

Level is an enum representation of the currently supported levels

```go
type Level int
```

```go
const (
    // None is the lowest level supported although
    // it deactivates logging rather then enables
    // it.
    None Level = iota
    // Debug is the lowest possible level of messages
    // to be logged, it will add a "DEBUG" prefix
    // to the given message.
    Debug
    // Info is the second log level.
    // It will add a "INFO" prefix.
    Info
    // Warn is the third log level.
    // It will add the "WARN" prefix.
    Warn
    // Error is the highest logging level.
    // It will add the "ERROR" prefix.
    Error
)
```
